jenn_cs: Heads-up: Acme renewal flagged after pilot. They hit unexpected token spend and occasional p95 spikes. Request: single-page "Pulse Playbook" we can send their engs + a tiny internal ops flipbook. Can we draft and assign? @arun_se @megan_sre

arun_se: I'll draft the customer-facing Pulse Playbook (short). Idea: 3 quick wins + one-line rollback instructions. Keep examples language-agnostic.

megan_sre: Ops flipbook should be minimal: pre-check, quick toggles (route -> lighter model, enable server prefix cache, enable soft token cap), and rollback. Also prepare a Console toggle template.

arun_se: Draft customer one-pager below (VERY short):
- Deterministic client cache — why: avoid re-sending identical context. Action: attach X-RW-Cache key (user + prompt hash) and set TTL 45s. Example header:
```
X-RW-Cache: user:{id}:sha:{sha256(prompt)}
Cache-TTL: 45
```
- Micro-batching at edge — why: reduce per-request overhead. Action: batch short requests with a 30-80ms hold window (batch_max=12). Example config snippet:
```json
{"batch_max":12, "batch_hold_ms":50}
```
- Streaming + truncate fallback — why: streaming improves first-byte; fallback reduces cost if latency spikes. Action: enable streaming with chunk_size=128 and add a truncate_on_timeout policy. Pseudocode:
```
if p95 > 400ms:
  route -> lighter_model
  enable truncate_on_timeout = true
```

arun_se: One-line ops fallback for the customer: "If you hit a spike, request 'Economy Mode' and include 3 request IDs from the last 10 minutes."

megan_sre: Internal flipbook (concise):
1) Pre-check: pull 3 example request IDs + spike window.
2) Canary: create route acme-slim -> llama-7b-128q, start 10% traffic.
3) If urgent: set acme-route -> 100% acme-slim, enable prefix cache, and apply soft token cap 5000/min. Commands:
```bash
redwood routes create acme-slim --model llama-7b-128q --from acme-route --split 10
redwood caches enable --route acme-route --prefix
redwood quotas update --scope customer:acme --tokens-per-minute 5000
```
4) Watch for 5m window: p95, tokens/min, error rate. Rollback: revert route split and disable cache.

metrics-bot: Canary created acme-slim id=canary-331 status=ok

jenn_cs: Great. Owners: Arun = customer email + playbook; Megan = ops flipbook + console toggle; Jenn = client coordinating & invite. Arun, paste a 1-paragraph cover note we can use.

arun_se: Cover note draft: "Hi Acme team — quick plan attached: three immediate engineering steps (deterministic client cache, edge micro-batching, and streaming with a truncate fallback) that are low-effort and often reduce both latency and token spend. If you'd like, we can enable an ops fallback (Economy Mode) while we validate with a 30-minute calibration window. Please share 3 sample request IDs if you want us to pre-check logs before the call. — Arun, CS"

jenn_cs: Sending now and scheduling calibration. Will ping thread with any customer replies. Closing once sent. :white_check_mark:
